IntegrationActionFormV1.description: Presentation and client-validation hints, not business semantics or authority. The installed host adapter validates arguments again. Null, absent, false, zero and empty text remain distinct.

IntegrationActionCatalogEntryV1.description: Available action configuration, not an execution grant or proof that future execution will be allowed. Titles and descriptions are untrusted data.

IntegrationActionCatalogV1.description: One bounded read-only page of native action forms. Discovery and saving a recipe never execute an operation.

IntegrationActionElementV1.description: Inert action presentation bound to exact immutable connector and operation versions. The host resolves the current grant revision when submitting; this control grants no authority.

arguments.description: Flat JSON record of at most 100 FieldId keys, excluding __proto__, prototype and constructor; scalar values only, strings at most 4096 characters and finite numbers. Application data, never authorization; the trusted registered adapter validates business fields and request bindings.
